en.description:
Highway Watch Car Race: Adrenaline on Your Wrist!
Experience high-speed thrills right on your Apple Watch! Highway Watch Car Race brings the classic arcade racing experience to your wrist—no iPhone required. Whether you’re waiting in line or on a quick break, the highway is always open.

Key Features:

Digital Crown Precision: Feel the road! Use the Digital Crown for ultra-smooth and precise steering. It’s the most intuitive way to race on a watch.

Standalone Experience: Leave your phone in your pocket. This game is built specifically and exclusively for watchOS.

Dodge & Survive: Weave through heavy traffic, avoid high-speed collisions, and see how far you can go.

Progressive Difficulty: As you go faster, the traffic gets tougher. Master the lanes and beat your own high scores!

Clean Arcade Graphics: Optimized visuals designed perfectly for the Apple Watch display to ensure smooth performance and battery efficiency.

How to Play:

Open the app on your Apple Watch.

Rotate the Digital Crown to steer your car left and right.

Avoid the red cars and stay on the road as long as possible!

Turn the crown, hit the gas, and dominate the highway. Download now and start your engine!
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/14SzVqLDEFDxqf3ZSAcm7pxzEfOd2uzqbE-ZlKHQ2Fbc/edit?usp=sharing
en.subtitle: Highway Traffic Driving Arcade
